title: BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.24578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is moving from the harness of prompts and tools around a base model toward the model itself. However, existing RSI still faces key challenges, including harness-bound gains that stay outside the base model, black-box supervision that reads only the model's outputs, and imprecise edits whose site and strength are fixed in advance. To address these challenges, we propose BaseRSI, a new paradigm of Recursive Harness Internalization: the base model improves its harness, then writes what the harness adds into its own weights through training-free edits, round after round on its own responses. To support this paradigm, we introduce ReGap, a mechanism that supervises every transformer block with the high-dimensional activation difference that the harness makes at that block alone, and updates the block's weights along this signal in a low-dimensional subspace. translated_title: BaseRSI：通过免训练的脚手架内化实现基础视觉-语言模型的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进正在从围绕基础模型的提示词和工具脚手架转向模型本身。然而，现有的RSI仍面临关键挑战，包括局限于脚手架之外、无法进入基础模型的收益，仅读取模型输出的黑盒监督，以及编辑位置和强度被预先固定而不够精确的编辑。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了BaseRSI，这是一种递归脚手架内化的新范式：基础模型改进其脚手架，然后通过免训练的编辑将脚手架所增加的内容写入自身权重中，并在自身响应上轮复一轮地进行。为了支持这一范式，我们引入了ReGap，这是一种用脚手架仅在该transformer块上产生的高维激活差异来监督每个transformer块的机制，并在低维子空间中沿着该信号更新该块的权重。在此机制的基础上，我们进一步提出了ReK
tldr: 提出BaseRSI新范式，让基础视觉-语言模型通过免训练编辑将脚手架带来的能力递归地内化到自身权重中，并借助ReGap机制实现对每个transformer块的精确监督与更新。
en_tdlr: Proposes BaseRSI, a recursive harness internalization paradigm that enables a base vision-language model to internalize harness improvements into its own weights through training-free edits, supported by the ReGap mechanism for precise per-block supervision and weight updates.
